verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a client-side 3D rendering library that runs inside the developer's own application. It hosts no production data or accounts, so a separate sandbox environment for isolating production data does not fit this kind of product. The 'Sandbox' at sandbox.babylonjs.com is only a model viewer that shares the name, and NullEngine is a headless rendering engine; neither is a sandbox-versus-production data environment, so the axis does not apply.
